global_style.summary: A tight, beat-locked motion-graphics edit: hard cuts every 0.7-1.5s landing on a ~120 BPM percussion track, one white flash-frame punctuation, continuous push/pull camera moves inside every shot, and fully saturated synthetic color fields. The core language is: hit the beat with a cut, keep the frame moving with a slow zoom, and use a flash frame to reset the eye between contrasting color worlds.

pacing.character: driving, beat-locked, accelerating feel from alternating zoom directions

color.treatment: saturated synthetic primaries; each shot is its own color world, no unified grade

sound.music: metronomic percussion/click track ~120 BPM, no melody
sound.sync_policy: cuts land on onsets; the 1.5s cut lands exactly on the heaviest bass impact

global_style.motion_language: every shot carries a continuous slow zoom; zoom direction alternates between consecutive shots (in, in, none, out, none, none); cuts handle big moves, zooms handle small ones; handheld jitter only inside the fractal shot

recurring_patterns.name: cut-on-impact
recurring_patterns.description: shot changes align to audio onsets; the strongest bass impact coincides with the 1.5s cut (measured delta 14ms)

recurring_patterns.name: perpetual push/pull
recurring_patterns.description: every textured shot has a slow continuous zoom; direction alternates to create breathing rhythm

recurring_patterns.name: flash punctuation
recurring_patterns.description: a single white flash frame separates contrasting color worlds and acts as a beat separator

content.footage_required: abstract motion-graphics test card: vertical color bars with sweeping diagonal light lines and a slowly rotating dotted arc; any high-saturation graphic with continuous internal motion works
content.subject_motion: diagonal lines sweep across the frame; dotted arc rotates top-right

transition_in.note: video opens cold on this shot

creative.intent: establish the graphic color world and start the first slow push

content.footage_required: organic fractal/mandelbrot-style bloom centered on a soft pink-lavender field; any organic detail-rich form that reads as 'zooming into a structure'
content.framing: centered macro on the fractal body
content.subject_motion: camera pushes into the fractal while the form itself breathes; visible handheld jitter

transition_in.note: hard cut on the heavy bass impact at 1.5s; total color-world change from saturated bars to pastel field

creative.intent: energy peak of the sequence: lands on the loudest impact, shakes with it

other: handheld jitter synced to the bass hit

content.footage_required: calibration bars (SMPTE-style): totally static, flat, reference-frame aesthetic; any static 'bench' image works as the palate cleanser
content.subject_motion: none; the stillness is the point

transition_in.note: 2-frame white flash at 2.2s separates the pink fractal world from the bars; measured, frame-accurate

creative.intent: deliberate stillness after the shake; the flash resets the eye into a calm world

content.footage_required: return of the SHOT_01 graphic world (color bars with sweeping lines); same family, slightly different composition
content.framing: full-frame graphic, wider than SHOT_01 by the end
content.subject_motion: same sweeping diagonal lines; frame pulls back steadily

transition_in.note: cut back to the saturated world; mirror of SHOT_01's push, now a pull

creative.intent: symmetry with SHOT_01: same world, opposite zoom direction

content.footage_required: soft animated gradient field (olive/purple/green washes drifting); extremely low spatial detail
content.subject_motion: slow color drift; measured feature confidence 0 so camera move is unknown - treat as static

transition_in.note: hard cut into the softest, quietest world; contrast with the bars

creative.intent: breathing space before the final graphic hit

content.footage_required: retro TV test circle: rainbow sweep bar across the bottom, circular graphic on black/white grid

transition_in.note: final hit; lands between beats, not on one - the only off-grid cut, which reads as a deliberate destabilizer

creative.intent: closer: the most 'designed' looking frame, held short
